description: Integer enums declaring a sized format. Each validator decodes into the sized type and compares with reflect.DeepEqual, so the allowed-values list has to hold that type too: an untyped list holds ints, matched nothing, and rejected every value, valid ones included.

IntegerFormatEnumMixed.description: A member too wide for the declared int32. Decoding can never produce it, so it is left out of the allowed values with a warning; keeping it used to mean keeping an untyped list, which rejected the valid members too.
